newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela gov't may decree wage rise - minister.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela gov't may decree wage rise - minister.

text.p: The Venezuelan government is studying, among other alternatives, publishing a decree that the private sector increase salaries, Labor Minister Maria Bernardoni said.
"The government is studying various alternatives among which is obviously the possibility of decreeing a salary increase," Bernardoni told reporters between government, union and business leaders.
Government officials have insisted recently that private sector wages must rise in accordance with agreements between labor, business and government over labor reform.
Finance Minister Luis Raul Matos Azocar has said that salaries must be raised for the government to carry out a 27 percent increase in gasoline prices Thursday as planned.
Union leaders have threatened to call a general national strike if salaries are not raised.
Business chamber leaders, meanwhile, have said that 90 percent of companies have raised salaries already.
Bernardoni said the government would consider a solution to the conflict at Wednesday's weekly cabinet meeting of ministers.
